verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ollama shipped a native GUI chat app for macOS/Windows with multimodal and markdown support (comm-16, comm-18), but it's Windows/macOS-only (no Linux) and lacks remote-instance connection (comm-17), plus some users criticized the move as scope creep (comm-19, comm-20). No official docs evidence describes the GUI directly, so quality is capped despite functional confirmation.
